capabilities: Send the active note to Claude Code CLI in real time
Send the current text selection as context
Connect to Claude Code via the /ide command
disambiguation: Not a chat client inside Obsidian; it only shares context with a Claude Code session running in an external terminal.
extras: Claude Code must be launched from the vault directory for workspace matching to work, per the README warning. The README is bilingual (Chinese and English).
motivation: The README says the goal is to make the experience match VS Code, where the editor automatically shares the open file and selection with Claude Code.
problem: Claude Code in a terminal has no awareness of which note you are working on in Obsidian, so you must manually pass files and selections as context.
summary: Real-time bridge that sends the active note and current text selection from Obsidian to a Claude Code CLI session as context.
